lines.text: God poured out His wrath on Israel for the blood they shed and their idols, and scattered them.
God had concern for His holy mountain, which they profaned among the nations, and He will show its holiness.
God will bring Israel back to their land, sprinkle clean water on them, and give them a new heart.
God will summon the grain, make the fruit of the trees plentiful, and bring no plague on them.
The desolate land will become like the garden of Eden, and God will multiply His people like a flock.
